FIREBALL RELEASE — arms thrust forward mid-cast, flaming orb streaking away from her palms trailing ember-sparks, atop a burning watchtower with siege engines visible below, her hair and cloak whipped back by the magical combustion, smoke billowing around her silhouette against the night sky.

RANGER MID-LOOSE — bow drawn to full anchor at her cheek, enchanted arrow already blurring from the string with blue-glow trail, standing on a forest ridge with bandits scattering in the valley below, her braid whipping sideways in the wind, quiver bouncing at her hip.

DIVINE WARHAMMER STRIKE — paladin mid-swing with two-handed maul overhead, golden divine light erupting from the weapon's head in radial beams, standing in a temple courtyard with shadowy figures recoiling, her armor glowing with channeled holy energy, mouth open in a battle cry.

ROOFTOP VAULT — sprinting assassin mid-leap between clay-tile rooftops, reversed dagger in her grip, lantern-lit night market twenty feet below with crowds parting, her dark cloak billowing behind her, legs tucked for the landing, pursuit torches visible on the roof she just left.

LIGHTNING CALLER — sorceress with both arms raised to storm clouds, violet lightning bolt forking down to strike her upturned palms, standing in an open field with grass flattened by wind, her hair standing on end from static charge, arcane sigils glowing at her feet.

BARBARIAN CHARGE — greataxe raised overhead mid-sprint, tribal war paint streaking her face, mouth open in a roar, enemy shields visible breaking formation ahead, dust and grass kicked up by her boots, leather and fur armor whipping with momentum, muscles coiled at the strike's apex.

CROSSBOW SNAP-SHOT — emerging from behind a stone column, heavy crossbow at her shoulder, bolt already blurring across the frame toward an off-screen target, castle corridor lit by wall torches, her eyes narrowed in focus, spent quarrels scattered at her boots from previous shots.

DRUID SHAPE-SHIFT — half-transformed mid-change, wolf fur erupting through splitting skin on her arms and face, human eyes still visible but glowing amber, crouched in a forest clearing with startled deer fleeing, her clothing tearing as her body expands and reshapes, moonlight streaming through canopy.

MOUNTED GALLOP — leaning low over her horse's neck at full sprint, banner streaming horizontal behind her, charging across an open battlefield with allied cavalry flanking, her braided hair merged with the horse's mane in motion blur, lance couched under her arm aimed forward.

ICE NOVA BURST — cryomancer with arms swept downward, expanding ring of jagged ice shards erupting outward from her feet shattering the cobblestones, standing in a city square with market stalls freezing over, her breath visible in the sudden cold, frost climbing the nearby fountain.

WALL-RUN ARCHER — sprinting sideways along a vertical battlement, bow drawn and releasing over her shoulder mid-stride, arrow streaking back toward pursuing guards, her body parallel to the ground defying gravity, castle courtyard spinning below, cloak horizontal with centrifugal force.

NECROMANCER SUMMON — arms outstretched downward, skeletal hands erupting from cracked earth around her boots clawing upward, standing in a graveyard with mist swirling, her eyes glowing sickly green, dark energy tendrils spiraling from her fingertips into the ground, moonlit tombstones tilting as the ground shifts.

ELDRITCH BLAST — warlock with one arm thrust forward, crackling violet beam boring from her open palm toward an unseen enemy, standing on a cliff edge with ocean waves crashing below, her face lit purple by the spell's glow, loose hair streaming back from the magical recoil.

ROPE BRIDGE ESCAPE — sprinting across swaying rope bridge, planks snapping and falling away behind her, jungle chasm yawning below with mist obscuring the bottom, her arms windmilling for balance, pursuit arrows thudding into the ropes, her face showing desperate concentration as the far anchor begins to tear loose.

MONK CHI-STRIKE — mid-air spinning kick with golden energy trailing her extended leg, body twisted impossibly horizontal, striking a temple gong that's cracking from the impact, monastery courtyard with shocked students watching, her wrapped fists glowing with channeled ki, bald head catching sunlight.

CLERIC HEALING-WAVE — kneeling with arms spread wide, golden dome of divine light expanding outward from her center, battlefield with wounded allies within the growing sphere, her face tilted skyward in prayer, holy symbols on her armor blazing bright, grass flattening from the magical pressure wave.

DIVING CLIFF ESCAPE — mid-air with arms spread wide, having just leaped from a coastal cliff, waterfall plummeting beside her, ocean waves far below, her cloak billowing upward like wings, pursuit guards visible on the cliff edge above, spray catching rainbow light, her face fierce and free.

THROWING AXE RELEASE — arm extended in follow-through, hand-axe tumbling away from her fingers blade-over-handle, firelight from burning wagon catching the spinning steel, standing in a caravan ambush scene with bandits diving for cover, her off-hand already reaching for a second axe at her belt.

PORTAL SUMMON — both hands tracing glowing sigils in the air, reality cracking open behind her in a vertical oval of swirling void-energy, standing in an arcane library with books flying from shelves in the magical wind, her eyes blazing white with channeled power, runes spiraling up her bare arms.

DRAGON-DIVE RIDER — gripping the horn-ridge of a diving dragon, wind plastering her against its neck, falling past a stone tower at terminal velocity, her eyes squinted against the airstream, longbow strapped to her back, the dragon's wings tucked tight, ground rushing up visible far below with tiny figures scattering.

SHIELD-BASH CHARGE — knight running behind raised tower shield, divine light glinting off the steel rim, hammer in her trailing hand cocked back ready to strike, charging through a siege courtyard with arrows sparking off the shield face, her armored boots throwing up sparks from the stone, war cry visible forming.

SCREE-SLOPE SLIDE — descending a steep mountain slope in a controlled slide, dust and gravel cascading around her boots, using a planted staff to control speed, alpine valley visible far below, her free hand gripping her hood against the wind, equipment bouncing on her pack, avalanche of stones trailing her path.

SHADOW-TENDRIL ERUPTION — dark warlock with arms raised, writhing black tendrils exploding from her shadow spreading across the ground, standing at a crossroads with lanterns guttering out as darkness spreads, her face half-shadow half-light, opponents visible retreating from the crawling void, purple energy crackling along the tendrils.

TAVERN-BURST ENTRY — exploding through swinging doors, sword half-drawn from hip scabbard in a blur of steel, crowded common room with patrons diving away from tables, her tracking eyes locked on a target across the room, kicked door still swinging behind her, tankards airborne from a bumped table.

DRAGONFIRE STANCE — standing at her dragon's massive shoulder, the beast mid-roar with gout of flame erupting from its maw illuminating the scene orange, castle wall visible ahead engulfed in dragonfire, her arm raised signaling the attack, face lit hellish by the inferno, her cloak snapping from the heat blast.
